text: 半亩方塘一鉴开，天光云影共徘徊
pinyin: bàn mǔ fāng táng yī jiàn kāi, tiān guāng yún yǐng gòng pái huái
literal: half · mu · square · pond · one · mirror · open, sky · light · cloud · shadow · together · linger
natural: a half-acre square pond opens like a mirror; sky light and cloud shadows drift across it together

meaning.en: A clear mind reflects everything, as a pond mirrors the sky; an image of the joy of reading.
meaning.zh: 半亩方塘像镜子一样展开，天光云影在其中徘徊；比喻读书使心境澄明。

equivalents: a mind clear as a mirror

examples.zh: 图书馆门口刻着“半亩方塘一鉴开，天光云影共徘徊”。
examples.en: '{}' is carved at the library entrance.

examples.zh: 老师用“半亩方塘一鉴开，天光云影共徘徊”形容读书时的清明心境。
examples.en: The teacher used '{}' to describe the clear mind of reading.

story.en: Zhu Xi wrote this as one of two poems on reading, using a pond fed by living water as a metaphor for the mind renewed by learning.
story.zh: 朱熹《观书有感》以池塘有活水来比喻读书使思想不断更新。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 问渠那得清如许？为有源头活水来
pinyin: wèn qú nǎ dé qīng rú xǔ, wèi yǒu yuán tóu huó shuǐ lái
literal: ask · it · how · get · clear · like · this, because · has · source · head · living · water · come
natural: how can it be so clear? Because fresh water keeps coming from its source

meaning.en: Keep learning and drawing on new sources to stay fresh in thought and work.
meaning.zh: 池塘清澈是因为有源头活水不断注入；比喻要不断学习才能保持思想鲜活。

examples.zh: “问渠那得清如许？为有源头活水来”，企业要不断创新。
examples.en: '{}': a company must keep innovating.

examples.zh: 我们为什么要终身学习？因为“问渠那得清如许？为有源头活水来”。
examples.en: Why learn for life? Because '{}'.

story.en: The second poem's closing couplet: the mind stays clear as long as new knowledge flows into it.
story.zh: 此为组诗中的结句：思想要清澈，须有新知源源注入。

usage.en: The 活水 / 源头活水 image is often used for fresh ideas.
usage.zh: “源头活水”常指不断更新的思想来源。

text: 小荷才露尖尖角，早有蜻蜓立上头
pinyin: xiǎo hé cái lù jiān jiān jiǎo, zǎo yǒu qīng tíng lì shàng tóu
literal: little · lotus · just · show · pointed · pointed · tip, already · has · dragonfly · stand · on · top
natural: the young lotus has barely shown its pointed tip, yet a dragonfly already perches on top

meaning.en: New talent or a new thing, however small, soon draws attention.
meaning.zh: 小荷刚露出尖角，蜻蜓已立在上面；比喻新生事物初露头角就受到关注。

examples.zh: 新人刚出道，就“小荷才露尖尖角，早有蜻蜓立上头”。
examples.en: The newcomer had only just debuted when '{}'.

examples.zh: 夏日池塘边，我看到“小荷才露尖尖角，早有蜻蜓立上头”。
examples.en: By the summer pond I saw '{}'.

story.en: Yang Wanli's 'Little Pond' is a four-line miniature of early summer, with a spring trickling quietly and a tender lotus leaf.
story.zh: 杨万里《小池》是一首描写初夏小池的绝句，景物细腻生动。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 接天莲叶无穷碧，映日荷花别样红
pinyin: jiē tiān lián yè wú qióng bì, yìng rì hé huā bié yàng hóng
literal: join · sky · lotus · leaves · endless · green, reflect · sun · lotus · flowers · special · kind · red
natural: lotus leaves stretch to the sky in endless green; lotus flowers glow in the sun with a special red

meaning.en: A magnificent summer view of lotus in full bloom.
meaning.zh: 莲叶连天一片碧绿，荷花在阳光下红得特别；描绘盛夏荷塘景色。

equivalents: a sea of lotus in summer

examples.zh: 西湖六月，“接天莲叶无穷碧，映日荷花别样红”。
examples.en: In June at West Lake: '{}'.

examples.zh: 作文里他引用“接天莲叶无穷碧，映日荷花别样红”来写夏天。
examples.en: In his essay he quoted '{}' to write about summer.

origin.source: 杨万里《晓出净慈寺送林子方》

story.en: Yang Wanli sent off his friend Lin Zifang at dawn from Jingci Temple by West Lake in midsummer.
story.zh: 杨万里清晨在西湖净慈寺送别友人林子方，写下六月西湖的景色。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 春色满园关不住，一枝红杏出墙来
pinyin: chūn sè mǎn yuán guān bù zhù, yī zhī hóng xìng chū qiáng lái
literal: spring · colour · full · garden · lock · cannot · hold, one · branch · red · apricot · out · wall · come
natural: spring's colours fill the garden and cannot be kept in; one spray of red apricot blossom reaches over the wall

meaning.en: Vitality cannot be contained; also used (humorously or critically) for a wife's affair.
meaning.zh: 满园春色关不住，红杏探出墙外；比喻生机无法阻挡，也被用来暗指女子外遇（红杏出墙）。

examples.zh: 新技术“春色满园关不住，一枝红杏出墙来”，传统行业也抵挡不住。
examples.en: New technology: '{}'; even traditional industries cannot hold it back.

examples.zh: 叶绍翁游园不遇，在园外吟出了“春色满园关不住，一枝红杏出墙来”。
examples.en: Ye Shaoweng, finding the garden closed to him, recited from outside the wall: "Spring cannot be held in the garden; a branch of red apricot reaches out over the wall."

story.en: Ye Shaoweng called on a friend whose garden gate was closed; the blossom reaching over the wall told him spring was inside.
story.zh: 叶绍翁访友不遇，见园门紧闭，却看到一枝红杏伸出墙外，知春意盎然。

usage.en: Take care: 红杏出墙 alone is often used of infidelity, so context matters.
usage.zh: 注意：单说“红杏出墙”常指婚外情，须视语境。

text: 山外青山楼外楼，西湖歌舞几时休
pinyin: shān wài qīng shān lóu wài lóu, xī hú gē wǔ jǐ shí xiū
literal: mountain · beyond · green · mountain · tower · beyond · tower, West · Lake · song · dance · what · time · stop
natural: beyond the hills more green hills, beyond the towers more towers; when will the singing and dancing on West Lake end?

meaning.en: A satire on rulers' indulgence while the country is in danger; also a literal description of endless hills and buildings.
meaning.zh: 山外有山楼外有楼，西湖上歌舞不休；讽刺当权者沉迷享乐，不顾国难。

examples.zh: 看到官员挥霍无度，我想起“山外青山楼外楼，西湖歌舞几时休”。
examples.en: Seeing officials squander money, I thought of '{}'.

examples.zh: “山外青山楼外楼，西湖歌舞几时休”，诗人对南宋朝廷的醉生梦死很失望。
examples.en: '{}': the poet was disgusted by the Southern Song court's heedless revelry.

story.en: Lin Sheng wrote this on the wall of an inn in Lin'an (Hangzhou), mocking the court that had settled comfortably in the south after losing the north.
story.zh: 林升题于临安旅店墙壁，讽刺南宋朝廷偏安江南、纵情享乐。

usage.en: Often used literally for endless scenery; 山外青山楼外楼 also means there is always someone better.
usage.zh: 也常指山外有山，喻强中自有强中手。

text: 采菊东篱下，悠然见南山
pinyin: cǎi jú dōng lí xià, yōu rán jiàn nán shān
literal: pick · chrysanthemums · east · fence · under, leisurely · naturally · see · south · mountain
natural: picking chrysanthemums by the eastern fence, I look up and calmly see the southern hills

meaning.en: The peaceful, unforced life of a person at ease in nature.
meaning.zh: 在东篱下采菊，不经意间抬头看见南山；形容悠然自得的田园生活。

examples.zh: 退休后他“采菊东篱下，悠然见南山”，过得很自在。
examples.en: After retiring he lives '{}' and is at ease.

examples.zh: 民宿门前挂着“采菊东篱下，悠然见南山”的对联。
examples.en: A couplet '{}' hangs in front of the guesthouse.

story.en: Tao Yuanming wrote the twenty 'Drinking' poems after leaving office; poem five celebrates a quiet mind amid human society.
story.zh: 陶渊明辞官归隐后作《饮酒》二十首，其五抒写身居人境而心远的闲适。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 结庐在人境，而无车马喧。问君何能尔？心远地自偏
pinyin: jié lú zài rén jìng, ér wú chē mǎ xuān, wèn jūn hé néng ěr, xīn yuǎn dì zì piān
literal: build · hut · in · human · realm, yet · no · carriage · horse · noise, ask · you · how · can · so, heart · distant · place · naturally · remote
natural: I built my hut among people, yet hear no clamour of carriages; you ask how this can be? A far-off heart makes any place secluded

meaning.en: Peace is a state of mind, not a place; a detached heart finds quiet anywhere.
meaning.zh: 住在人间却听不到喧嚣，因为心境远离尘俗，所处之地自然僻静。

equivalents: peace is in the mind, not the place

examples.zh: 再吵的办公室也能专心，所谓“结庐在人境，而无车马喧。问君何能尔？心远地自偏”。
examples.en: One can concentrate even in the noisiest office, as in '{}'.

examples.zh: “结庐在人境，而无车马喧。问君何能尔？心远地自偏”，他住在市中心却过得很平静。
examples.en: '{}': he lives downtown yet leads a calm life.

story.en: The opening of Tao Yuanming's fifth 'Drinking' poem explains how he can live quietly in the world of men.
story.zh: 《饮酒·其五》开篇，说明作者身居人境却心无尘俗。

usage.en: Often cut to 心远地自偏.
usage.zh: 常缩为“心远地自偏”。

text: 少无适俗韵，性本爱丘山
pinyin: shào wú shì sú yùn, xìng běn ài qiū shān
literal: young · lack · suit · common · tune, nature · originally · love · hill · mountain
natural: from youth I had no taste for common ways; by nature I loved hills and mountains

meaning.en: A free spirit by temperament, unsuited to worldly conventions and drawn to nature.
meaning.zh: 从小就不适应世俗，天性喜爱山水田园。

examples.zh: 他总说自己“少无适俗韵，性本爱丘山”，不适合坐办公室。
examples.en: He often says '{}' of himself, and that he is not cut out for an office.

examples.zh: “少无适俗韵，性本爱丘山”，陶渊明自述其志。
examples.en: '{}': Tao Yuanming described his own bent.

story.en: Tao Yuanming wrote 'Returning to Fields and Gardens' after resigning as magistrate of Pengze in 405, glad to leave 'the dusty net' of office.
story.zh: 陶渊明辞去彭泽令后作《归园田居》，自述天性爱自然，不适应官场。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 久在樊笼里，复得返自然
pinyin: jiǔ zài fán lóng lǐ, fù dé fǎn zì rán
literal: long · in · cage · inside, again · get · return · nature
natural: long shut in a cage, I can at last return to nature

meaning.en: Relief at escaping constraints and returning to a natural, free life.
meaning.zh: 长久困在笼中，终于回到自然；形容摆脱束缚、重获自由的喜悦。

equivalents: free as a bird at last

examples.zh: 辞职回乡后，他感叹“久在樊笼里，复得返自然”。
examples.en: After resigning and returning home he sighed '{}'.

examples.zh: 放假出游，真是“久在樊笼里，复得返自然”。
examples.en: On a holiday trip: '{}' indeed.

story.en: From the same poem: the 'cage' is official life, from which Tao has escaped.
story.zh: 同一首诗：笼指官场生活，诗人终于摆脱。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 种豆南山下，草盛豆苗稀
pinyin: zhòng dòu nán shān xià, cǎo shèng dòu miáo xī
literal: plant · beans · south · mountain · under, grass · thick · bean · sprouts · sparse
natural: I plant beans at the foot of the southern hill; the weeds are thick and the bean seedlings sparse

meaning.en: A modest farmer's lack of success; often quoted with humour about poor harvests of any kind.
meaning.zh: 在南山下种豆，杂草繁茂豆苗稀少；描写农事不成，现常自嘲收获不佳。

examples.zh: 我的阳台菜园“种豆南山下，草盛豆苗稀”。
examples.en: My balcony vegetable plot is '{}'.

examples.zh: 陶渊明虽然“种豆南山下，草盛豆苗稀”，仍然乐在其中。
examples.en: Though '{}', Tao Yuanming enjoyed it all the same.

story.en: Tao Yuanming describes his early attempts at farming after returning home, rising early to weed, walking back by moonlight.
story.zh: 陶渊明写归田初期的耕作：虽然收成不好，仍乐此不疲。

usage.en: Often used jokingly of a poor harvest; also the line before 晨兴理荒秽，带月荷锄归.
usage.zh: 常用于自嘲收成不佳；下文为“晨兴理荒秽，带月荷锄归”。

text: 盛年不重来，一日难再晨。及时当勉励，岁月不待人
pinyin: shèng nián bù chóng lái, yī rì nán zài chén, jí shí dāng miǎn lì, suì yuè bù dài rén
literal: prime · years · not · again · come, one · day · hard · twice · dawn, seize · time · should · exert · urge, years · months · not · wait · for people
natural: the prime of life does not come again, nor does a day have a second dawn; strive in good time, for the years wait for no one

meaning.en: Treasure your time, because youth does not return and time waits for nobody.
meaning.zh: 青春不会再来，一天不会有两个早晨；应抓紧时间努力，岁月不等人。

equivalents: time and tide wait for no man

examples.zh: 毕业典礼上，校长说：“盛年不重来，一日难再晨。及时当勉励，岁月不待人”。
examples.en: At graduation the principal said: '{}'.

examples.zh: 墙上贴着“盛年不重来，一日难再晨。及时当勉励，岁月不待人”的座右铭。
examples.en: The motto '{}' is stuck on the wall.

story.en: Tao Yuanming urges himself to value time, setting joys of drink beside the passing of life.
story.zh: 陶渊明感叹人生易逝，勉励自己及时努力。

usage.en: Often shortened to 岁月不待人 or 及时当勉励.
usage.zh: 常缩为“岁月不待人”或“及时当勉励”。

text: 老骥伏枥，志在千里。烈士暮年，壮心不已
pinyin: lǎo jì fú lì, zhì zài qiān lǐ, liè shì mù nián, zhuàng xīn bù yǐ
literal: old · steed · lie · stable, aim · lies · thousand · li, heroic · man · evening · years, grand · heart · not · cease
natural: an old steed in its stall still sets its mind on a thousand li; a hero in his twilight years never gives up his great ambitions

meaning.en: Even in old age, people of ambition keep their drive and aims.
meaning.zh: 年老的千里马伏在马槽边，志向仍在千里；有志者到晚年雄心不减。

equivalents: an old war-horse still longs to run

examples.zh: 八十岁的院士仍在做实验，真是“老骥伏枥，志在千里。烈士暮年，壮心不已”。
examples.en: The eighty-year-old academician still does experiments: '{}' indeed.

examples.zh: 老同志用“老骥伏枥，志在千里。烈士暮年，壮心不已”自勉。
examples.en: The veteran quoted '{}' to spur himself on.

story.en: Cao Cao wrote this on returning from his northern campaign in 207, in his fifties, reflecting on life and ambition.
story.zh: 曹操北征乌桓得胜归来，年过五旬，作《龟虽寿》抒发壮志。

usage.en: Often quoted of older people who keep working with enthusiasm.
usage.zh: 常用于称赞老年人仍然奋斗不止。

text: 对酒当歌，人生几何
pinyin: duì jiǔ dāng gē, rén shēng jǐ hé
literal: face · wine · should · sing, human · life · how · much
natural: facing wine, let us sing: how long is a human life?

meaning.en: Life is short, so make the most of time, drink and good company.
meaning.zh: 面对美酒应当高歌，人生能有多长？感叹人生短暂，应当及时。

equivalents: life is short; drink and be merry

examples.zh: 宴会上，有人吟起“对酒当歌，人生几何”。
examples.en: At the banquet, someone chanted '{}'.

examples.zh: “对酒当歌，人生几何”，别再为小事纠结了。
examples.en: '{}': stop agonising over small things.

story.en: Cao Cao's 'Short Song' opens with the brevity of life and passes to a plea for talented men to join him.
story.zh: 曹操《短歌行》以人生苦短起笔，进而表达渴求贤才的心愿。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 慨当以慷，忧思难忘。何以解忧，唯有杜康
pinyin: kǎi dāng yǐ kāng, yōu sī nán wàng, hé yǐ jiě yōu, wéi yǒu dù kāng
literal: passionate · should · with · generous, worry · thoughts · hard · forget, with · what · dispel · worry, only · have · Du Kang
natural: we sing with passion, yet cares are hard to forget; what can dispel the worry? Only Du Kang (wine)

meaning.en: When troubles weigh on the mind, wine is the traditional (if unwise) remedy.
meaning.zh: 忧愁难忘，只有借酒消愁；杜康是传说中的造酒人，代指酒。

examples.zh: 失恋那晚，他念叨着“慨当以慷，忧思难忘。何以解忧，唯有杜康”。
examples.en: On the night of the break-up he mumbled '{}'.

examples.zh: “慨当以慷，忧思难忘。何以解忧，唯有杜康”，酒厂拿这句话做广告。
examples.en: '{}': the distillery used the line in advertising.

story.en: Du Kang is the legendary inventor of wine; Cao Cao's line moves from worry to a longing for worthy men.
story.zh: 杜康是传说中的造酒始祖；曹操由忧思转入对贤才的渴望。

usage.en: Often used humorously for drinking; 杜康 is a name for wine.
usage.zh: 常含调侃，“杜康”代指酒。

text: 本是同根生，相煎何太急
pinyin: běn shì tóng gēn shēng, xiāng jiān hé tài jí
literal: originally · are · same · root · grow, each other · fry · why · too · hasty
natural: we grew from the same root; why be so eager to fry each other?

meaning.en: A plea against harming one's own kin or comrades.
meaning.zh: 本是同根而生，何必这样急着互相残害；劝诫亲人、同胞之间不要自相残杀。

examples.zh: 同事之间争功，真是“本是同根生，相煎何太急”。
examples.en: Colleagues fighting for credit: '{}' indeed.

examples.zh: 兄弟为遗产打官司，有人感叹“本是同根生，相煎何太急”。
examples.en: When brothers sued over an inheritance, someone sighed '{}'.

story.en: According to tradition, Cao Pi ordered his brother Cao Zhi to compose a poem in seven steps or die; he improvised, comparing beans boiled over beanstalks.
story.zh: 相传曹丕命弟弟曹植七步成诗，否则处死；曹植以煮豆燃萁作喻，讽刺兄弟相残。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 大道之行也，天下为公
pinyin: dà dào zhī xíng yě, tiān xià wéi gōng
literal: great · Way · of · practice · particle, all · under · heaven · be · public
natural: when the Great Way prevails, the world is shared by all

meaning.en: The ideal of a fair society in which everything belongs to all.
meaning.zh: 大道施行的时候，天下是公共的；表达公平、共享的社会理想。

examples.zh: 孙中山常书写“大道之行也，天下为公”。
examples.en: Sun Yat-sen often wrote the words '{}'.

examples.zh: 教科书用“大道之行也，天下为公”介绍大同社会。
examples.en: The textbook uses '{}' to introduce the ideal of great harmony.

story.en: In the 'Liyun' chapter of the Book of Rites, Confucius describes the age of Great Harmony, when public good, worthy leaders, trust and care for all prevailed.
story.zh: 《礼记·礼运》中，孔子描述大同社会：天下为公，选贤与能，讲信修睦，人人得到照顾。

usage.en: Associated with 大同; Sun Yat-sen's favourite motto.
usage.zh: 与“大同”理想相关，孙中山常以此题词。

text: 玉不琢，不成器；人不学，不知道
pinyin: yù bù zhuó, bù chéng qì, rén bù xué, bù zhī dào
literal: jade · not · carved, not · become · vessel, people · not · learn, not · know · the Way
natural: jade unpolished does not become a vessel; a person who does not learn does not know the Way

meaning.en: Just as raw jade needs working, people need education to become worthwhile.
meaning.zh: 玉石不经雕琢成不了器物，人不学习就不懂得道理。

equivalents: jade must be cut; people must learn

examples.zh: 爸爸常对我说：“玉不琢，不成器；人不学，不知道”。
examples.en: My father often says to me: '{}'.

examples.zh: 教室的墙上写着“玉不琢，不成器；人不学，不知道”。
examples.en: '{}' is written on the classroom wall.

story.en: The 'Xueji' chapter of the Book of Rites is an early essay on education; it compares study to the shaping of jade.
story.zh: 《礼记·学记》是早期教育专论，以雕琢玉器比喻学习的必要。

usage.en: Often shortened to 玉不琢，不成器.
usage.zh: 常缩为“玉不琢，不成器”。

text: 先帝创业未半而中道崩殂，今天下三分，益州疲弊，此诚危急存亡之秋也
pinyin: xiān dì chuàng yè wèi bàn ér zhōng dào bēng cú, jīn tiān xià sān fēn, yì zhōu pí bì, cǐ chéng wēi jí cún wáng zhī qiū yě
literal: late · emperor · found · enterprise · not yet · half · and · midway · die · died, now · realm · three · divided, Yi · Province · weary · worn, this · truly · danger · urgency · survive · perish · of · autumn · particle
natural: the late emperor's great enterprise is not half done and he has died midway; now the realm is split in three and Yi Province is worn out; this is truly a critical moment of survival or ruin

meaning.en: Describes a moment of grave crisis in which survival or collapse is at stake.
meaning.zh: 先帝大业未成半途去世，如今天下三分，益州疲弱，这确实是生死存亡的紧要关头。

examples.zh: 公司现金流断裂，“先帝创业未半而中道崩殂，今天下三分，益州疲弊，此诚危急存亡之秋也”。
examples.en: The company's cash flow broke down: '{}'.

examples.zh: 语文课上，老师要求背诵“先帝创业未半而中道崩殂，今天下三分，益州疲弊，此诚危急存亡之秋也”。
examples.en: In Chinese class, the teacher asked us to memorise '{}'.

story.en: Before setting out on his northern expedition in 227, Zhuge Liang submitted this memorial to Liu Shan, reviewing the state's weak position.
story.zh: 227年诸葛亮北伐前，上表后主刘禅，陈述蜀汉形势危急。

usage.en: Often shortened to 危急存亡之秋 for a critical moment.
usage.zh: 常缩为“危急存亡之秋”，指生死攸关的时刻。

text: 亲贤臣，远小人，此先汉所以兴隆也；亲小人，远贤臣，此后汉所以倾颓也
pinyin: qīn xián chén, yuǎn xiǎo rén, cǐ xiān hàn suǒ yǐ xīng lóng yě, qīn xiǎo rén, yuǎn xián chén, cǐ hòu hàn suǒ yǐ qīng tuí yě
literal: be close · worthy · ministers, keep distant · petty · men, this · Former · Han · therefore · flourished, be close · petty · men, keep distant · worthy · ministers, this · Later · Han · therefore · collapsed
natural: keep close to worthy ministers and far from petty men: this is why the Former Han prospered; keep close to petty men and far from worthy ministers: this is why the Later Han collapsed

meaning.en: A ruler or leader who values the worthy and avoids flatterers will succeed; the reverse leads to ruin.
meaning.zh: 亲近贤臣、疏远小人，国家兴隆；亲近小人、疏远贤臣，国家衰败。

equivalents: surround yourself with the wise, not flatterers

examples.zh: 老板应牢记“亲贤臣，远小人，此先汉所以兴隆也；亲小人，远贤臣，此后汉所以倾颓也”。
examples.en: A boss should remember '{}'.

examples.zh: 历史书中引用“亲贤臣，远小人，此先汉所以兴隆也；亲小人，远贤臣，此后汉所以倾颓也”说明用人的重要。
examples.en: The history book quotes '{}' to show the importance of choosing people well.

story.en: Zhuge Liang urges Liu Shan to learn from the history of the Han dynasty in choosing his advisers.
story.zh: 诸葛亮以两汉兴衰的教训，劝后主刘禅亲贤远佞。

usage.en: Often shortened to 亲贤臣，远小人.
usage.zh: 常缩为“亲贤臣，远小人”。

text: 非淡泊无以明志，非宁静无以致远
pinyin: fēi dàn bó wú yǐ míng zhì, fēi níng jìng wú yǐ zhì yuǎn
literal: not · plain · simple · none · with · show · aims, not · calm · quiet · none · with · reach · far
natural: without simplicity you cannot make your goals clear; without tranquillity you cannot go far

meaning.en: Clear goals and long-term achievement need a simple, calm mind free of distractions.
meaning.zh: 不淡泊名利就无法明确志向，不宁静专一就无法达到远大目标。

examples.zh: 备考期间，他把“非淡泊无以明志，非宁静无以致远”贴在桌前。
examples.en: During exam preparation he stuck '{}' on his desk.

examples.zh: “非淡泊无以明志，非宁静无以致远”，做研究要耐得住寂寞。
examples.en: '{}': research demands the ability to bear solitude.

story.en: Zhuge Liang wrote this letter of admonition to his young son Zhuge Zhan, urging study and self-cultivation.
story.zh: 诸葛亮写给儿子诸葛瞻的家书，教导他修身立志、勤学不怠。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 是日也，天朗气清，惠风和畅
pinyin: shì rì yě, tiān lǎng qì qīng, huì fēng hé chàng
literal: this · day · particle, sky · bright · air · clear, gentle · breeze · mild · pleasant
natural: on this day the sky is bright and the air clear, the gentle breeze soft and mild

meaning.en: A perfect spring day of clear skies and mild breezes.
meaning.zh: 这一天天空晴朗，空气清新，和风温暖舒畅；形容春日天气宜人。

examples.zh: 春游那天，真是“是日也，天朗气清，惠风和畅”。
examples.en: On the spring outing, it truly was '{}'.

examples.zh: 朋友圈配文用了“是日也，天朗气清，惠风和畅”。
examples.en: The post's caption used '{}'.

story.en: Wang Xizhi wrote the preface to the poems composed at the 353 Orchid Pavilion gathering, with cups of wine floating along a stream.
story.zh: 353年三月初三，王羲之与友人在兰亭曲水流觞，作序记其盛会。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 中通外直，不蔓不枝，香远益清，亭亭净植，可远观而不可亵玩焉
pinyin: zhōng tōng wài zhí, bù màn bù zhī, xiāng yuǎn yì qīng, tíng tíng jìng zhí, kě yuǎn guān ér bù kě xiè wán yān
literal: inside · hollow · outside · straight, not · creep · not · branch, fragrance · far · more · clear, graceful · upright · clean · stand, can · from afar · view · but · not · can · trifle · play · particle
natural: hollow within, straight without, neither creeping nor branching; its fragrance spreads far and grows purer; it stands tall and clean, to be admired from afar, not handled idly

meaning.en: Praise of the lotus as the model of an upright, clean, dignified person.
meaning.zh: 赞美莲花内空外直、不枝不蔓、香远益清，比喻品格高洁、令人敬重。

equivalents: admired from afar, not trifled with

examples.zh: 语文课上，我们背诵了“中通外直，不蔓不枝，香远益清，亭亭净植，可远观而不可亵玩焉”。
examples.en: In Chinese class we recited '{}'.

examples.zh: 他用“中通外直，不蔓不枝，香远益清，亭亭净植，可远观而不可亵玩焉”称赞这位正直的老师。
examples.en: He used '{}' to praise the upright teacher.

story.en: Zhou Dunyi's short essay 'On Loving the Lotus' compares the chrysanthemum to the recluse, the peony to the wealthy and the lotus to the gentleman.
story.zh: 周敦颐《爱莲说》以菊喻隐士，牡丹喻富贵者，莲花喻君子。

usage.en: Often broken up; 出淤泥而不染 and 香远益清 are widely quoted.
usage.zh: 常拆开引用，“出淤泥而不染”“香远益清”最广为人知。

text: 以铜为镜，可以正衣冠；以古为镜，可以知兴替；以人为镜，可以明得失
pinyin: yǐ tóng wéi jìng, kě yǐ zhèng yī guān, yǐ gǔ wéi jìng, kě yǐ zhī xīng tì, yǐ rén wéi jìng, kě yǐ míng dé shī
literal: with · bronze · as · mirror, can · straighten · robe · cap, with · past · as · mirror, can · know · rise · fall, with · people · as · mirror, can · see · gains · losses
natural: use bronze as a mirror to straighten your clothes; use the past as a mirror to know why states rise and fall; use people as a mirror to see your own gains and losses

meaning.en: Learn from history and from other people, as well as from the mirror, to see yourself clearly.
meaning.zh: 用铜镜可整理衣冠，用历史可了解兴衰，用别人可发现自己的得失。

equivalents: learn from history and from others
hold up a mirror to yourself

examples.zh: 开会时书记引用了“以铜为镜，可以正衣冠；以古为镜，可以知兴替；以人为镜，可以明得失”。
examples.en: At the meeting the secretary quoted '{}'.

examples.zh: 复盘项目时，他说：“以铜为镜，可以正衣冠；以古为镜，可以知兴替；以人为镜，可以明得失”。
examples.en: Reviewing the project he said: '{}'.

story.en: Tang Taizong said this after the death of his chief adviser Wei Zheng, who had often criticised him frankly.
story.zh: 魏徵去世后，唐太宗感叹失去一面可以明得失的镜子。

usage.en: Often shortened to 以人为镜 or 以史为鉴.
usage.zh: 常说“以人为镜”“以史为鉴”。

text: 人之初，性本善
pinyin: rén zhī chū, xìng běn shàn
literal: human · of · beginning, nature · originally · good
natural: at the beginning, people are by nature good

meaning.en: People are born good, and education and surroundings shape what they become.
meaning.zh: 人刚出生时本性是善良的；强调后天教育的重要。

examples.zh: 幼儿园老师带孩子们读“人之初，性本善”。
examples.en: The kindergarten teacher led the children in reading '{}'.

examples.zh: “人之初，性本善”，他相信每个孩子都能教好。
examples.en: '{}': he believes every child can be taught well.

story.en: The Three Character Classic, a Song-dynasty primer traditionally attributed to Wang Yinglin, opens with Mencius's idea of human goodness.
story.zh: 《三字经》相传为南宋王应麟所作，开篇采用孟子性善论。

usage.en: The opening of the 《三字经》, the traditional primer; often recited by children.
usage.zh: 《三字经》开篇，传统蒙学读物，孩子常诵读。
